summary.headline: Perambulations and Life Periods
summary.text: Astrological delineation of the lord of the question’s lifespan and intermediate fortunes through perambulations of the Moon and ascendant. It discusses climacterics, distributions through Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus, bodily illness, women, study of salvation and death, honor, money, and the effects of the ascending node.
